title: Hybrid-Propulsion UAV Testbed
description: A skeletal UAV testbed designed to expose propulsion, energy-storage, control, and payload interfaces for rapid access. The open tubular structure supports subsystem iteration and ground testing before aerodynamic fairings or production packaging are finalized.
